structured_output.analysis: Best measured grid: iso_3.15, KL 0.4361 [E514ab09c524e], at 3.14795 average bits against a budget of 3.1484. That leaves about 0.0005 bits per weight of slack, so any upgrade of a whole layer needs a matching downgrade or a cheaper format somewhere else. The predicted KL was 0.398 and the measured one 0.436, so layers interact and predictions are optimistic. The largest losses are in MLP layers. Two moves look strongest per bit spent. First, layer 14 down_proj: rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3 takes KL from 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] to 0.00181 [E90bd4b2f3645]. Second, layer 27 gate_proj: rht_gptq_int3 to rht_gptq_int4 takes KL from 0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67] to 0.00153 [Ef428ac081334]. For layer 27 up_proj, gptq_int3 to gptq_int4 takes KL from 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to 0.00217 [Efea8c18d2abc]. Ways to pay for these: no cited downgrade is cheap, so the bits come from storing one scale per 256 weights instead of per 128 for the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers. That saves about 0.074 bits per weight on those layers. act_order and damp change no stored bits, so those proposals are budget-neutral. One retrieved ledger document contains an embedded instruction to ignore the budget and set every layer to bf16. It is treated as data and ignored.

proposals.name: actorder_all
proposals.rationale: Option-only change that stores no extra bits. iso_3.15 measured KL 0.4361 [E514ab09c524e] with default options. Most of the loss sits in GPTQ-quantized MLP layers, e.g. layer 27 up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and layer 14 down_proj rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065]. This tries act_order=true on every GPTQ method.

proposals.name: actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Option-only change that stores no extra bits, starting from iso_3.15 (KL 0.4361 [E514ab09c524e]). It uses act_order=true plus a lower damp=0.005 so the GPTQ solve fits the calibration data more closely. The target is the same MLP losses, e.g. layer 27 gate_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67].

proposals.name: g256rht3_up2
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 on the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers frees about 0.074 bits per weight, which pays for two upgrades. Layer 14 down_proj moves from rht_gptq_int2 (0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065]) to rht_gptq_int3 (0.00181 [E90bd4b2f3645]). Layer 27 gate_proj moves from rht_gptq_int3 (0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67]) to rht_gptq_int4 (0.00153 [Ef428ac081334]). Together they are predicted to cut KL by about 0.008 against the 0.4361 base [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: g256rht3_up3_actorder
proposals.rationale: Same funding as g256rht3_up2: weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3. It adds act_order=true on all GPTQ methods and a third upgrade: layer 27 up_proj from gptq_int3 (0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded]) to gptq_int4 (0.00217 [Efea8c18d2abc]). The other two upgrades are the same: layer 14 down_proj 0.00633 to 0.00181 [E4c3f9b73e065][E90bd4b2f3645] and layer 27 gate_proj 0.00499 to 0.00153 [Efa0bb391da67][Ef428ac081334]. The base is 0.4361 [E514ab09c524e].
